title: God's Word
description: Psalm 119 — the longest chapter in the Bible — is all about loving and living by God's Word. It shows how Scripture guides, protects, and gives joy.

waypoints.title: A Lamp and a Light
waypoints.body: Psalm 119 has 176 verses, all about one thing: how much the writer loves God's Word. It shows Scripture as a lamp for dark paths, a guard against sin, and a source of joy.

waypoints.title: A Verse That Guided You
waypoints.body: What's one verse that has helped guide a decision you made? If you can't think of one yet, that's okay -- keep hiding God's word in your heart.
